[/p][p]Here's the full overview for September[/p][list][*][p][b]A-maze-ing[/b] : August 28th - September 10th[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dream: Vacation[/b] : September 4th - September 17th[/p][/*][*][p][b]Handle with Car[/b] : September 11th - September 24th[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dream: Zoo[/b] : September 18th - October 1st[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/b591ca10ee85d466747baf5a1b2d233ea7ebbbea.png"][/img][/p][p]We're busy dreaming up themes so if you have a good idea, don't hold back, let us know - what are you dreaming of? Only one month away from Spooky Season! 👻[/p][p]HONK HONK,[/p][p]- Sarah (Community Manager)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/1985a7061864e5296e3705ebdebe9fbb194bdcc1.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🚀BEST OF CAR-MONG US - NOW LIVE🚀
notes.content:
[h2]New Among Us x WHAT THE CAR? content![/h2]

that's live right now! (and technically has been since Thursday but eh, time isn't real anyways).

A car, a crewmate and a seagull walk into a fungle... if you think that's the beginning to a bad joke, you're right.

In the newest Car-mong Us update, you'll find: [list]
[*] new overworld map with Fungle Theme!
[*] hand-picked player made levels
[*] little secrets and silly dialogue

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/6afbc1e191aeef228379e0c2c689083c83abaca2.gif[/img]
[i](Horrifying worm-like level we came across in our player-level hunt! This is apparently what happens when you give players free will)[/i]

⚒ CHANGES & FIXES ⚒

● [b]Changed the "DAILY LEVEL"[/b] to show hand-picked player made levels! So now YOUR level might get featured as the daily level! 

Yes, this does mean the previous levels there are removed from the game & the Ghost Car... Let us know in the comments what you think of this change! Also also, definitely share your levels here or on Discord in #car-share-your-level and we might consider them for the roster!!!

[b]Changes and fixes[/b]
● Fixed some crowns not displaying properly on UGC levels that had been won
● Adjusted the length of leaderboards to only show top 100 on all tabs
● Fixed a bug that would cause the sasquatch to float away from the car when sitting
on it
● Fixed a bug that would display post-its as blank when they are supposed to say
"dum"
● Fixed the flickering in the fog in some levels before ejecting from the cannon
● Fixed some props clipping into other props in various places
● Fixed some UGC levels not displaying a crown on the entry point after winning
● Fixed some specials showing as "completed" when they were not yet completed

Try to challenge yourself by completing enough levels to get elusive 🌈rainbow skin🌈. Why pick ONE color for CAR when you can be ALL of them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/15fba2176cdc9d3d6e0c304af5612647c394aa75.gif[/img]

New things cooking, especially Quality of Life changes (like the elevator/dungeon remapping!) 
also... we love hearing from you guys! Write us and let us know what you think of our updates 👀


Ejecting myself into space soon,
- Sarah (Community Manager)


[url=https://discord.gg/triband]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/1985a7061864e5296e3705ebdebe9fbb194bdcc1.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: 🏆BEST OF 2024🏆- Now live!
notes.content:
[h3]Happy New Year! 🥳[/h3]

Thanks for playing our games and joining our silly shenanigans! It's been wonderful seeing this community grow as we got to introduce our games to even more players! 

In 2024 we [list]
[*] Participated in seven showcases worldwide including PAX West in person in Seattle (not even counting the online ones here!)
[*] Got nominated for multiple awards including a Webby, Danish Game Award and Apple Design Award
[*] WHAT THE CAR? WON multiple awards in different categories at the DICE Award, Spilprisen, BIG Festival and Cinekid Festival!
[*] Streamers like Smii7y, Stumpt, CTop, DSimphony, GameGrumps, Ray Narvaez Jr, Jenna Stroeber, Sam Tabor and hundreds more played our games!
[/list]
We also [list]
[*] ate 240 cakes 🍰
[*] made at least 4 stupid jokes
[*] fixed 624 bugs in WHAT THE CAR?[/list]
and there's been 378.508 levels made by players in WHAT THE CAR? ! 🤯 

The new WHAT THE CAR? update[strike] has been whoops[/strike] is live where we highlight [i]some [/i]of our favorite levels made by players. Some are tricky, some are just crazy, some we just like because you get to explore new creative ways to use the level creator! 🔨🏆

notes.title: PATCH 5.4.0
notes.content:
Its ONE WEEK FROM CHRISTMAS and here's a little patch update for WHAT THE CAR? 

Go sit somewhere cozy and imagine a lively fireplace, or just like, open a YouTube video with one and take a skim through the report ⏬

[h1] 🛠 CHANGES AND FIXES SUMMARY 🛠 [/h1]

[list]
[h3]OVERWORLD[/h3]
[*] Fix for not being able to complete 'The Gang's All Here' achievement. This means that current live users who have 7/8 characters will get the achievement next time they appear in the home hub.
[*] Fuse from the Frogger level in the swamp finishes in the middle of nowhere
[*] Fixed glitching Dialogue Alert Icon
[*] Community Level Bug in License to Car / Removed the extra crown pad in the book
[*] Certain cheering bears appear green when you unlocked them after the elevator. They are a normal bear-brown now.
[*] New elevator: Car got tossed too far when exiting the elevator under certain conditions. Now it gets tossed a normal amount.
[*] New elevator: Fixed overlapping text in certain languages
[*] Ice week 2024: Sign at elevator had overflowing text in a certain language
[*] Swamp skull level: Got boosted the wrong place after skull level.
[*] Cable from generator was clipping under the ground in every overworld
[*] Hallo-wheels Hunt: removed Z fighting on the ground at the elevator
[*] Fixed issues with the duck displayed on a screen in the ... goose... mini-game found in Episode 5: DRIVING

[h3]LEVELS[/h3]
[*] In CAR NEEDS AN ICEBREAKER the button was for 'HONK' but the action was jumping - now it matches!
[*] Certain bike stages have low FPS and stutters on Steam Deck; this should be adjusted now!
[*] JUMP THE ROPE level: trees were blocking the view of the car in the end shot. Can't mess up the money shot!
[*] The wire keeping the big cranes in CAR WITH LARGE LEGS onboarding did not rotate with the crane itself. Rotate enabled.
[*] A couple of things were floating in the last onboarding level. Get dun. 
[*] Ice week 2024: Players were able to get stuck in a gap in the stage CAR NEEDS AN ICEBREAKER - patched this.
[*] Ice week 2024: Certain intro words were not pronounced correctly
[/list]

We keep an eye on any feedback regarding difficult times or potential cheating, so give us a shout here on the community page or on Discord and we'll take a look!

You can also report bugs right here on Steam (Steam Community) or on our [url=https://discord.gg/triband]Discord[/url] at #car-bugs. Our bug-bears read them all the time and catch up as soon as possible! <3

Remember when reporting bugs, please add what device you're on and some clear description of the issue (picture or video helps a lot)

MERRY WHEELSMAS & HAPPY HONKS,
- Sarah (Community Manager)

notes.title: ❄ ICE TO MEET YOU ❄ - NEW LEVELS Now live!
notes.content:
[h1] ❄ NEW LEVELS ALERT ❄[/h1]

Prepare yourself for a new barrage of ice cold puns and goofy levels!

We've added [b]SIX[/b] new levels to the ICE TO MEET YOU special AND expanded the surroundings a bit. Go explore the multitude of silly jokes we've added and get into that festive winter mood 🎄

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/d30abbad96730e041d127cb1c7edb5db599cd34a.gif[/img]

[h3]THE CLASSIC ICE LEVELS:[/h3]
SLIDE ON ICE WEEEEE
ICE ICE LEGGY
IT'S ALL DOWNHILL FROM HERE
NO NEED FOR SNOW TIRES
SIR YOUR FISH IS FROZEN

[h3]THE NEW ICE LEVELS:[/h3]
BOB SLED WHO'S THAT?
FREEZING BREEZES CAUSES SNEEZES
IT'S THE ICING ON THE CAR
WHAT A SNOW PLOW
CAR NEEDS AN ICEBREAKER
SNOWBALL FIGHT?

[h1]📷 THUMBNAIL GUIDE 📷 [/h1]

[h3]Did you know you can make custom thumbnails for levels you publish?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/d9190ca741ca991edba79b6f2d8fdb3cf44807a2.png[/img]

[h3]HOW TO MAKE CUSTOM THUMBNAILS:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Make your level
[*] When selecting the name with the dial, choose the thumbnail button in the top right
[*] Take a picture from the level!
[/list]

[*] Fixed shiny material (it’s NOT shiiineeyy ✨)
[*] Removed bananas from Screen Falling animation
[*] Checked cell overload before releasing a prop from a Move Car in the Level Maker

[*] Fix to animator for bear on the horsespring Jump Hypezone

notes.title: EARLY BIRD PRICE ENDS OCTOBER 9TH
notes.content:
Hello dear car-noisseurs! 🚖

This is a PSA that our Early [strike]Bird [/strike]Car price ends on October 9th.

After that, the price of WHAT THE CAR? will be 19.99 USD.

🍌 That means you still have TWO WEEKS to snag it at the low price of 9.99 USD 🍌 

[b]Q: Will it be on sale later?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] Yes, probably.

[b]Q: Why are you increasing the price?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]Our launch price was an “Early Bird” pricing where the first people who picked it up (potentially still you if you’re reading this right now!) got a chance to grab it at a lower price. We’ve gotten some feedback with people questioning whether there was less stuff in WTC? than our first game WTG? due to the price difference, which is contradictory since there’s more stuff in WTC?

The price change is going to reflect the value of the game a lot better 🧡

[b]Q: Will you sell any physical copies? [/b]
A: No, but you can go outside and look at a real copy of a car (no legs though, sadge). 

[b]Q: But it’s my birthday on the 9th..?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] It’s actually my birthday. Hand over your presents. Gimme.

notes.title: HOTFIX 4.5.2
notes.content:
Hope you've all had a nice weekend! CAR and the bears have been off on shenanigans.

Y'all are ENERGETIC about reporting bugs so we've done a second pass over the things you've spotted! Grab a nice drink and have a skim through the report.



[h1] 🛠 HOTFIX SUMMARY 🛠 [/h1]

[list]
[*] Specials and dailies didn't get counted towards their achievements; this should be corrected now! Go get those achievements, gang!
[*] Remix UGC pads in specials don't show crowns for completion. You dropped this, king 👉👑
[*] The bear at the start of Wind Special update has its speech bubble disappear right away. Let him speak!!!
[*] In Episode 4: LONGER you can spawn after a closed barrier. Oopsie
[*] SteamDeck: UI was scaled too small 🤏 Should be easier to read now!
[*] Jumping on top of building for gold shortcut in the skull level Escape Car-tist was too unreliable. RIP to everyone who went for this before the patch 💀
[*] Getting the card on top of tent of DO CARS DREAM OF GIRAFFE WHEELS? required too much acrobatics. The giraffes should be slightly easier to wrangle now. Just slightly. 🦒
[*] In Episode 1: JUMPING you could skip the barrier by falling in the water. We've put baby railings up now.
[*] In THEY SEE ME ROLLING you lost all your NYOOMENTUM when entering a road. That felt bad. It should be rolling better now. 👩‍💼
[/list]

As part of the fix, we've also adjusted the difficulty in getting gold in some levels, overall. This round was particularly focused on the Sas-Car levels! We listen all the time to your feedback on all levels, so please let us know (either here or on Discord) and we'll dig back into others too!

You can either report bugs right here on Steam (Steam Community) or on our [url=https://discord.gg/triband]Discord[/url] at #car-bugs. We're reading them erry week, and catch up as soon as possible! <3

Remember when reporting bugs, please add what device you're on and some clear description of the issue (picture or video helps a lot)!

notes.title: 24 HOURS TO GO! // MORE ON EPISODES & FAQ
notes.content:
Hello my little car-lings!

[h1]IN 24 HOURS YOU'LL BE ABLE TO BUY THE SILLY CAR GAME[/h1]

[h3]Q: When exactly does it come out? I need to set my sundial.[/h3]
A: September 9th at 3PM CEST

[h3]Q: How long is WHAT THE CAR?[/h3]
A: This is all just estimations, since we don't fully know how long it'll take for people (feel free to register your playthrough on [url=https://howlongtobeat.com/]HowLongToBeat [/url]when its out!), but we're guessing:
~ 5-7 hours (by just completing main game);
~ 9-12 additional hours of gameplay in going for gold score, cards, secrets;
~ unknown amount of hours when playing or creating player-made levels 🤷🏼‍♀️

[h3]Q: Can I get the soundtrack somewhere? It's honkin'[/h3]
A: Sune, the mastermind behind the catchy tunes, is unfortunately a busy and sought after man. We'd love to create a whole album, but it'll take some time. Spring is our best estimate at the moment.

[h3]Q: Can I make video content/stream the game? [/h3]
A: Please, please do! And tag us when you do! There are no issues with the copyright of the music, so feel free to use and blast that too - just remember the credit somewhere. 

[h3]AIGHT let's get into the other episodes:[/h3]

[h1]Episode 5: DRIVING[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/bd41a63b4f0dbf8bce338f73654a8bed9c13ad90.gif[/img]

I know. Wheels? In my leg-car-game? We were really thinking out of the box with this one. Of course it's using wheels in the worst (best?) ways possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/467e677287a15885f1a19f90a9a98a8aaf20fa16.gif[/img]

[h1]Episode 6: WATER[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/3d9e1f026010584412cf3c2adcfd56601af6e24b.gif[/img]

Beach episode! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/a0e219b747baa574996415dff8312550d5a51da1.gif[/img]

[h1]Episode 7: SNEAKY SAS-CAR[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/4632fad8131789b7f6629cca2d89e5778c99ef06.gif[/img]

Car meets a new friend! This is our first crossover with another world, called Sneaky Sasquatch. The theme of the episode is basically going camping, with some extra sasquatchy activities pebbled in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/08fdbbaaf8ee654435378f29d83f1f2c5545b369.gif[/img]

[h1]Episode 8: SANDSTORM![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/b8d43cc9cb6173163c5f9a2801c5a2fba355edb4.gif[/img]

Silly car game gets super tuned. This episode features a new playmode where you get chased through a never ending sandstorm! Mad Max - Dune-ish hijinks ensues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/d04b46c7d823687d5608e6dc77048d05cac3c86a.gif[/img]

[url=https://discord.gg/triband]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892499/1985a7061864e5296e3705ebdebe9fbb194bdcc1.png[/img][/url]

So! What adventures should CAR go on in the future? It is a live game after all, and we listen to ideas you come with!
What world should we go to next?
What are you excited for when you get your little grabby car-hands on it? 
Let us know ⏬⏬⏬

HOOOOONK,
Sarah
Car-munnity Manager
